items.title: Asia stocks roar back as Taiwan jumps 6%, Nvidia probe rattles AI trade
items.summary: Investing.com -- Asian stocks rallied on Monday, following a recovery on Wall Street, although concerns over an investigation involving Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang tempered gains as investors reassessed the outlook for the artificial intelligence trade.

items.title: Expert: Nvidia Probe Could Weaken China Leverage
items.summary: Mehran Gul, author of "The New Geography of Innovation," says the investigation into Nvidia's Jensen Huang could diminish his leverage with the US government over China. He speaks on "Bloomberg: The China Show."
